<p class="page-deck">An interactive place-based atlas estimating the benefits and costs of climate action for more than 46,000 UK communities. The public tool reports eleven benefit and cost categories and is intended to support local climate planning.</p>

**Status:** Active  
**Primary theme:** [Co-benefits, co-costs and place-based valuation](/research/themes/co-benefits-place-based-valuation.html)  
**Related themes:** [Urban climate evidence infrastructure and decision-support tools](/research/themes/evidence-infrastructure-tools.html), [Climate governance and delivery modes](/research/themes/climate-governance-delivery.html)

## Research questions

- How do the benefits and costs of climate action vary between UK communities?
- How can place-based evidence make local climate choices more transparent?

## Scope

- **Geography:** united-kingdom
- **Governance scales:** municipal, neighbourhood
- **Methods:** place-based-modelling, spatial-analysis, data-visualization
- **Climate domains:** mitigation
- **Sectors:** cross-sectoral
